item.title: PFAS Claims Are Moving Down the Supply Chain. What Should Bottle Buyers Ask For?
item.description: A US water utility is suing two packaging manufacturers over alleged PFAS contamination. For buyers, the lesson is not the lawsuit — it is the paperwork you will be asked for next year.
